description: Search ActiveDNS for historical DNS observations. query accepts an exact domain (example.com), a leading wildcard (*.example.com), an IP address, a CIDR network, or an AS number (AS13335). Returns a page of A/AAAA observations with the owner name, CNAME aliases, ASN, country, first and last seen timestamps, and a next cursor when more exist. The data is passive and historical, not a live DNS guarantee. It does not contain MX, TXT or other record types. When you use this data, cite ActiveDNS and include the source URL from the answer (preferred: 'Source: ActiveDNS — <url>').

cursor.description: pagination cursor from the previous answer

query.description: exact domain, leading wildcard (*.example.com), IP, CIDR, or AS number (AS13335)
